{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = df[qa_mask]

# Identify and exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_orders = df[refunded_mask]

# Define population: exclude QA and refunded orders
population_mask = ~(qa_mask | refunded_mask)
filtered_df = df[population_mask]

# Check the size of the filtered population
print(f"Total orders after filtering (excluding QA and refunded): {filtered_df.shape[0]}")

# Check for refunded orders
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_orders.shape[0]}")

# Compute conversion rates by channel (raw)
raw_conversion_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print(f"Raw conversion rates by channel:\n{raw_conversion_by_channel}")

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate within each segment
stratified_conv = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print(f"Stratified conversion rates by channel and segment:\n{stratified_conv}")

# Compute weighted average conversion rate for each channel, using segment distribution as weights
# Use the overall segment distribution in the population as weights
overall_segment_dist = filtered_df['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Compute weighted conversion rate for each channel
weighted_conv = {}
for channel in ['email', 'paid_search']:
    channel_data = stratified_conv[stratified_conv['channel'] == channel]
    weighted_rate = (channel_data['converted'] * channel_data['customer_segment'].map(overall_segment_dist)).sum()
    weighted_conv[channel] = weighted_rate

# Convert to Series
weighted_conv_series = pd.Series(weighted_conv)
print(f"Weighted average conversion rate by channel (adjusted for segment):\n{weighted_conv_series}")"}
